glasses_omar: I assumed nightstand_b1 or bathroom_shelf_ba1, but it was at bathroom_shelf_ba1 at 07:54 and coffee_table_l1 at 22:13. Pattern: Highly variable; moves between bathroom, living room, and bedroom. Do not assume a fixed spot; check bathroom_shelf_ba1, coffee_table_l1, and nightstand_b1.

razor_omar: I assumed sink_ba_ba1, but it was at bathroom_shelf_ba1 at 07:53. Pattern: Location varies between shelf and sink. Check both bathroom_shelf_ba1 and sink_ba_ba1.

mug_omar: I assumed cupboard_k1, but it was at coffee_table_l1 at 21:29. Pattern: Frequently in the living room in the evening, not the kitchen cupboard. Check coffee_table_l1 before cupboard_k1.

charger_omar: I assumed bed_b1 or nightstand_b1, but it was at entry_hook_e1 at 22:59. Pattern: Moves to the entry area at night, not just the bedroom. Check entry_hook_e1 for late-night queries, then nightstand_b1.

glass_omar: I assumed nightstand_b1, but it was at cupboard_k1 at 22:59. Pattern: Moves from kitchen to bedroom at night, but can remain in kitchen storage. Check cupboard_k1 and nightstand_b1.

General: Items do not follow consistent time-based patterns. Evening locations are dynamic. Always consider multiple rooms (kitchen, living, bedroom, entry) rather than assuming a single fixed spot based on time of day.
